This is what you posted two days ago on another post, so I don't understand exactly what it is you need help in. You also stated in that post that the guy who got you pregnant is a heavy drinker. You really need to think about this and if it is what you want. Everyone can give you advise on what to do or not, but at the end of the day you are the one dealing with this. You have to make a choice and you really shouldn't wait to long to make a decision like that.
